description: Generate one index.html that serves a for-sale page for every parked domain in a portfolio, with the same offer email on each. Returns the HTML file and where to upload it; nothing is stored or sent, so the caller uploads it. Handles up to 500 domains. Use set_listing_terms instead to set terms on a domain already listed on this market. Read-only.

domains.description: Parked domains to include, up to 500. Each item has a domain and an optional priceUsd asking price in US dollars.

email.description: The address that receives offers from every generated page.

note.description: Optional note for the generated page, up to 500 characters.

name: build_portfolio_lander
title: Build a portfolio landing page
